name: cleanframework
description: Semantic CSS framework built for human-AI collaboration. Beautiful websites with intuitive class names that both humans and AI understand.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.version: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),v=require('./package.json').version;for(const f of ['README.md','AI-README.md'])fs.writeFileSync(f,fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8').replace(/cleanframework@v[0-9.]+/g,'cleanframework@v'+v)+'')" && npm run build && git add README.md AI-README.md cleanframework.min.css cleanframework.min.js

author: Tom Von
